title: AdversarialTransformationRecord
description: Schema for adversarial and linguistic transformations in BanglaFactBench Split E

original_claim_id.description: Identifier of the source clean claim (e.g., BFB-HLT-0001)

transformation_id.description: Unique identifier for this transformed instance (e.g., BFB-HLT-0001-TYPO)

transformed_claim_text.description: Perturbed claim text under the specified transformation

transformation_method.description: Algorithmic rule or model applied to generate the perturbation

semantic_preservation_judgment.description: Validation that the transformation maintains the original ground truth meaning

ground_truth_label.description: Expected label (should match original unless deliberately inverted)

levenshtein_distance.description: Character-level edit distance between original and transformed text
